tool_description: List owner-scoped GHOST memory metadata without returning complete stored episode bodies.

Use list_mode collection_folders to list Main, ordinary Collection subfolders, and Archive. Use collections with an optional folder to list Collections directly in exactly one location; omitting folder means Main.
Use collection_episodes with an exact Collection ID for one active Collection's numbered episode metadata.
server_instruction: Use ghost_memory_list only for metadata discovery. For 'list Collections' use list_mode collections with no folder, which means Main only. For 'list folder X' use list_mode collections with folder X. For 'show Collection folders' use list_mode collection_folders.
Archive is listed only when the user selects Archive as the folder. Archived Collections are physical metadata and are not active SQLite-backed Collections.
Use list_mode collection_episodes with the exact Collection ID for one active Collection's numbered metadata. Do not present List results as complete recalled Q/A content.

field_descriptions.list_mode: Select memories, collections, collection_folders, or collection_episodes.
field_descriptions.collection_id: The exact stable Collection ID required by list_mode collection_episodes.
field_descriptions.folder: Optional exact Collection location for list_mode collections. Omit for Main; use one ordinary folder or Archive.
